candidates: Output S3 bucket resource referenced by OUTPUT_BUCKET in the IaC template
answer.explanation: Every ThumbnailerFunction invocation in the window fails at S3 PutObject with NoSuchBucket, which means the bucket named in OUTPUT_BUCKET does not exist. The error is NoSuchBucket rather than AccessDenied, so the execution role is not the cause. The fault is a misconfigured bucket name in the live environment variable, or a bucket missing or renamed in the IaC template, and the logs alone cannot tell these apart. CrudApi, Uploader and Compression run normally in the same window. No tool output was available, so this conclusion rests only on the log excerpt.
